# Pseudocode for a simplified version of the inspection records falsification process

```
declare a list of safety audits performed on various dates by different inspectors.
for each audit in the list:
    check each checklist item for signs of tampering or errors.
    analyze each checklist item to determine its potential impact on the overall safety of a facility.
    identify any checklist items that have been tampered with or contain erroneous information.
    remove any checklist items that have been tampered with or contain erroneous information from the safety audit database.
    update the safety audit records in the appropriate database.
    increment the index to move to the next audit.
end loop.
update the safety audit records in the appropriate database.
declare a new set of safety audits with updated checklists and corrected records.
```
